claim: Turnstile's default (normal) widget is a fixed 300px wide; flexible is 100% with a 300px minimum; compact is 150x140
evidence: https://developers.cloudflare.com/turnstile/get-started/client-side-rendering/widget-configurations/ (read 2026-10-07): «Normal | 300px width × 65px height», «Flexible | 100% (min: 300px)», «Compact | 150px width × 140px height»; retry and refresh-expired default to auto.

claim: error.js does not catch errors in the layout above it; the root layout needs global-error.js; error.js gets retry() (stable) and reset()
evidence: https://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/file-conventions/error (docs version 16.4.0, updated 2026-10-06): «It does not wrap the layout.js or template.js above it in the same segment. To handle errors in the root layout, use global-error.js»; retry «became stable» in v16.3.0, and «In most cases, you should use retry() instead» of reset(). Installed next is 16.3.5; its builtin global-error renders the English «This page couldn’t load» in <html id="__next_error__"> (node_modules/next/dist/client/components/builtin/global-error.js).

claim: error.tsx: «A render error (static export: only client-side) … the rooms are linked from the header»
evidence: The boundary is inside the (public) root layout, so the header and footer stay rendered around it; it only covers the page segment, not the layout's own client components (see DSN-PAGES-11).
